## The signal magnitude formation when for 180 deg flip

![The signal magnitude formation when for 180 deg flip.](images/ch10/the-signal-magnitude-formation-when-for-180-deg-fl.png){#fig-ch10-the-signal-magnitude-formation-when-for-180-deg-fl}

The link on this page goes to a very nice web-site for quantitative MRI.

That site includes references to Joelle Barral and Nikola Stikov’s work in fitting these kinds of data.

Barral:  A robust methodology for in vivo T1 mapping

Stikov:  On the accuracy of T1 mapping: Searching for common ground

If you don’t want to just produce an image, but you want to know the T1, you can use this method by Joelle Barral at Stanford

Original method by Look Locker
